Based on the CF, NetCDF, HDF5, Parquet and NeXus specifications and Pangeo community practice.

- https://cfconventions.org - CF metadata conventions
- https://www.unidata.ucar.edu/software/netcdf/ - NetCDF
- https://www.hdfgroup.org/solutions/hdf5/ - HDF5

- https://pangeo.io - Pangeo community (cloud-optimized scientific data practice)
